# kompact

> A Claude Code plugin that scores every tool call before context compaction and
> drops only what is no longer needed verbatim — locally, with no API key, no GPU
> and no network call. It keeps the file, not a summary of it.

kompact replaces Claude Code's summarise-and-forget compaction with a local
logistic scorer over facts already computed for each tool call. Every claim on
the site is measured and carries its uncertainty; negative results are shown too.

## What it does
- Scores each tool call and keeps only outputs still needed verbatim.
- Never drops a mutating call, or an answer you gave (AskUserQuestion result,
  approved plan) — asking again would be a new question.
- Hands back to Claude Code's own summary, not a half-compacted transcript.

## Measured results (see /eval.html and /evidence.html)
- Ranking quality (result-needed), leave-one-session-out over 41 sessions: AUC 0.789.
- Paired corpus (1063 calls, 10 grouped splits): AUC 0.905 +/- 0.078, worst split 0.684, ECE 0.019.
- "Output size alone" baseline: AUC 0.876 — most of the signal is one feature.
- ~29% of tokens freed on real sessions; ~281 ms to score 3,591 tool calls.
- A better neural scorer (Laya sidecar) was tried and lost: best AUC 0.721.

## Install
- Enable hooks: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1
- claude plugin marketplace add AxeForging/kompact
- claude plugin install kompact
